# More shapes and per-level tower height
Owner requested U/凹 and T/凸 combinations and taller towers after promotion. Keep first two tutorials, 46.8 square grid cells, five-column 234 tower, hero/pad sizes and touching start. Level3 retains L; level4 introduces U; level5 introduces T. From level3 onward rows=level+3, adding one row per level. U has three bottom cells plus upper corners; T has three bottom cells plus upper center. Fill cutouts with separate squares so initial towers remain fully supported and no cells overlap. Alternating three-column left/right assemblies and original L assemblies preserve variety. Use real compound physics for all irregular pieces, never a filled rectangle. Turns0/2 preserve their3×2 bounds; L retains quarter turns. Existing camera follows tall towers; no change to lives/ad rules.
